name: Browser-use
tagline: Open-source browser automation agent driven by local or cloud LLMs
real_test_summary: Automated a 6-step product price extraction workflow on macOS M2 16GB RAM using Qwen 2.5 14B via Ollama without external API calls.
pros: Works with local Ollama models for zero API cost
MIT license suitable for commercial automation
cons: Requires 14B+ parameter models for reliable DOM reasoning
install_command: pip install browser-use && playwright install chromium
description: Python library that connects local LLMs via Ollama to Playwright browsers so AI agents can click, scrape, fill forms, and navigate multi-step web workflows locally.
